rules.description: Supplier shall design, manufacture, integrate, test, and commission an automated Infrastructure Monitoring System for Buyer's fourteen (14) regional water-distribution monitoring nodes, including sensors, communication hardware, central software platform, and staff training, in accordance with the Statement of Work (Exhibit A) and Technical Specifications (Exhibit B).

rules.description: If the DEL milestone is not completed by the Required Delivery Date, Supplier shall pay Buyer liquidated damages of $4,500 per calendar day of delay, beginning on the first day after the Required Delivery Date. A grace period of fourteen (14) calendar days applies; no penalty accrues within the grace period. If delay exceeds 14 days, all days from day 1 are penalised retroactively (threshold trigger, not an offset).

effects.description: Liquidated damages payment from Supplier to Buyer at $4,500 per day
Penalties calculated from day 1 of delay, not day 15

constraints.description: No penalty accrues within 14-day grace period; if delay exceeds 14 days, all days from day 1 are retroactively penalized
Late delivery penalties shall not exceed $405,000 (7.5% of Contract Price)

rules.description: If SAT reveals defects, Supplier shall remedy at its own expense. The elapsed time between Buyer's written Defect Notice and Supplier's written confirmation of remedy is the 'Correction Period.' The Revised Delivery Date for penalty and incentive purposes equals the Actual DEL Date plus the Correction Period, subject to a maximum addition of 45 days across all correction rounds.

rules.description: Any and all disputes, claims, or controversies arising out of or relating to this Agreement, including disputes concerning its formation, performance, breach, termination, or validity, shall be resolved exclusively by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association ('AAA') under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, as modified by this Section 14. The arbitration shall be conducted in Austin, Texas, before a single arbitrator selected from the AAA's Large Complex Case roster.
